PAGE SCAN

Made for paper of all kinds.

Capture a page

Keep the whole page in view. Good light helps.

From paper to a clearer picture.

  1. Bring a page. Take a photo or import a JPEG, PNG, WebP, or another image your browser can decode. A dark border or contrasting table helps.
  2. Check the corners. Automatic detection suggests the page. Drag the four handles to correct it. With a keyboard, focus a handle and use arrow keys; Shift moves faster.
  3. Set the proportions. Choose a known size or enter custom dimensions. Photo proportions are an estimate, especially at an angle.
  4. Keep your scan. Straighten, adjust the finish, and download an image. Add multiple pages to export one PDF.

Processing happens on your device. Page images are not uploaded. Camera access needs HTTPS and your permission; photo import is always available. This version corrects perspective on flat pages; it does not flatten curved book pages or recognize handwriting. Very large images are reduced to a maximum 2,800 px edge for reliable mobile processing. Output scans have a maximum 2,600 px edge.

Write a page.

Editable strokes stay in this tab until you download them. This canvas does not transcribe handwriting.
